findings.text: The increment's sole new file is not among the node's declared write paths: the dispatch fences reckon/serve.py, reckon/mcp.py, reckon/_store.py, tests/test_a_roadmap_read_answers_from_its_snapshot.py and the evidence fragment, and never names reckon/roadmap_snapshot.py. The move was the prescribed remedy for the width finding (the ALLOWLIST stays empty) and this review's own goal names the file, so the scope is understood rather than disputed; recorded because no widen appears on the run and the fence as written would not have permitted the write.

after_suite.command and the baseline_suite.command on line 25 carry an unexpanded $PY, the word 'then serially' and the angle-bracket placeholder '<the gate's files that exist at the base>', so neither field is the literal command that ran and neither can be interpreted without hand work. The cited log headers (split4-head-gate.log:4, base-gate.log:6) carry the literal commands and remain the re-runnable form; the same field defect was recorded on the previous review at this node and persists.

The source done-when requires that ruff check and ruff format --check findings on every changed path do not exceed the base, but no ruff log appears under test_logs and the only record is the worker's closing claim of 20-before/20-after on serve.py; the increment deletes an import and a large block, so the claim is plausible, but it is a claim rather than a recorded measurement.

The moved comment reads 'which is the behaviour this section removes', citing a plan section inside source; the naming rules forbid plan references in comments and ask that they be scrubbed in place when a change passes through the code. The comment travelled verbatim with the move, so the increment carries it into the new owner module.

VERDICT done_when: the source done-when names tests/test_a_roadmap_read_answers_from_its_snapshot.py plus the roadmap/serve gate files adding zero failures at head against the base arm with logs closing in EXIT=; manifest.md:24-25 records 39 passed in the head parallel arm and 14 in the serial arm against 39 at the base, both EXIT=0 with zero failure ids, and split4-width.log records reckon/serve.py at 48,381 estimated tokens under the 50,000 bound with 4 passed and EXIT=0.
VERDICT write_paths: the dispatch fences reckon/serve.py, reckon/mcp.py, reckon/_store.py, tests/test_a_roadmap_read_answers_from_its_snapshot.py and the evidence fragment; the gained diff touches reckon/serve.py and the test file inside that fence and creates reckon/roadmap_snapshot.py outside it.
VERDICT manifest: read manifest.md; status complete, commits through e5ca59486, after_suite and baseline_suite both zero failures, negative_control_log points at split4-negative-control.log which ends EXIT=1 with the reuse arm's 'stable' != 'stable' failure, and the suite command fields are not literal commands.
VERDICT diff: read e5ca59486 against f1fdfee7b commit by commit; one commit, three files, a verbatim move of the key builder, the live-run readings and the snapshot path/load/store into reckon/roadmap_snapshot.py, a re-export import block at reckon/serve.py:171-180, and two driver rebinds at tests/test_a_roadmap_read_answers_from_its_snapshot.py:56 and 535 so the negative control and the clock move on the module the builder reads.
